Primary Audience: Enterprise AI leads, ML platform maintainers, risk owners, security/privacy teams and internal governance teams
Problem Solved: AI systems, intended uses, owners, model/tool versions, data sources, human checkpoints and control evidence are scattered across documents and repositories, making reviews difficult to reproduce.
Unique Differentiator: An inspectable AI system register connected to engineering artifacts, model/tool/data provenance, human checkpoints, evidence hashes and a tamper-evident audit trail. Risk indicators disclose unknowns and never pretend to be legal classifications.
Creator: Vatsal Shah
Community / Contributor Angle: Open governance schemas, IDE adapters, policy packs, framework mapping contributions, evidence connectors and synthetic test fixtures.
Demo Idea: Register a sample AI assistant, scan a repository for AI SDK/MCP declarations, assess its context, attach evidence hashes and export an auditable review packet.
First Milestone: Build the local AI system registry, transparent risk indicator, safe repository discovery, evidence reference store, audit verifier and read-only local API.
Expanded Development Description: Local-first AI governance workspace tracking AI system identity, intended/prohibited use, owner/risk owner, model and tool versions, data sources, affected people, deployment context, human checkpoints, controls, evidence references, exceptions and review dates. Includes JSON schema, deterministic risk indicator, completeness checks, allowlisted package, lockfile and MCP scanner with owner manifests, pointers and digests, change diff, ten pass/fail/unknown rules, human-only exceptions with expiry, sealed audit report, secret-safe behavior, SHA-256 evidence references, hash-linked JSONL audit, JSON/Markdown/HTML reports, token-protected loopback read API, CLI and project-local IDE adapters. No raw data ingestion or hosted API key required.
First Developer Demo: Run the synthetic Customer Support Knowledge Assistant fixture; produce a 42/100 internal prioritization indicator, read the ten-rule table (pass, unknown), discover four repository candidates (including a lockfile-resolved SDK version and a digest-verified manifest), diff a tool-permission change, export reports and the sealed audit report in MD/HTML/JSON, and verify the audit chain.
MVP Readiness: Starter Built (Verified) + M1 core shipped in v0.2.0 - 80 automated tests, 31-check sealed audit report (MD/HTML/JSON), seeded fuzzing; local-only; Node 22+; GitHub public; not a compliance certification.
